name: Skillsail
description: Skillsail turns Claude into a course author. Connect your Skillsail workspace and build complete, interactive eLearning modules through conversation, with no separate authoring tool required. Ask in plain language and Claude will draft a full module from a prompt or an uploaded document, then refine it slide by slide: adding content slides, multiple-choice quizzes, and interactive activities like games and scenarios; generating slide images and narrated voiceovers on demand; managing languages with automatic translation; setting themes and completion rules; and publishing modules as shareable links or reusable templates. A live module preview renders right in the chat, so you can watch slides take shape as you edit. When you're done, export to any LMS as SCORM 1.2, SCORM 2004, xAPI, or cmi5, or as a standalone HTML5 package. Everything happens in your own workspace, scoped to the organization you sign in with, and destructive actions are clearly flagged so Claude confirms before making irreversible changes. Ideal for L&D teams, trainers, and educators who want to go from idea to LMS-ready course without leaving the chat.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Skillsail to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Skillsail to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://skillsail.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Skillsail MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Skillsail lists 38 MCP tools, including add_interactive_activity, add_question, add_slide, copy_template, create_module, delete_component, delete_module, delete_resource, edit_image, export_module, generate_slide_image, and generate_slide_voiceover.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Skillsail?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Skillsail in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Skillsail requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Skillsail is developed by Skillsail GmbH. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
